title: Contract Sales and Advisory Services Competitive Landscape
summary: Assessment of a major merged contract sales, marketing, medical affairs, and advisory organization formed through PE consolidation with $1B+ annual revenue.

findings.org_structure: PE-backed merger of 40+ operating companies into four divisions: marketing communications (~$340M), field engagement (~$300M), medical affairs (~$290M), and strategic advisory (~$85M). 10,500+ employees.
findings.technology_influence: CSOs deploy field teams using client CRM systems. Platform preferences and training capabilities influence CRM selection. Internal engineering teams build custom integrations and field tools on top of client platforms.
findings.market_consolidation: PE-backed consolidation creating fewer, larger players with deeper technology capabilities, concentrating CRM platform influence and pressuring vendors to maintain strong CSO partnerships.

source: Competitive assessment of PE-backed contract sales and advisory services organization
